sharedConstraints: Photorealistic premium automotive editorial photograph, landscape 3:2. Correct model proportions and authentic body design. Whole car, all wheels and roof fully within frame with generous 15 percent margins. No other cars, people, signs, readable text, added logos or watermark. Blank unlettered license plate. Small authentic vehicle emblems allowed. Natural perspective, realistic lighting and reflections. Single photo, not collage.
